items.title: John Harbaugh: Giants are "just not good enough" at generating explosive runs
items.text: The longest run from a Giants running back this season was a 13-yarder by Cam Skattebo.

items.title: Tyler Shough limited in practice with left hand injury
items.text: Saints quarterback Tyler Shough had his left hand hit in Monday night's loss to the Falcons but played all 74 snaps.

items.title: Seahawks DT Jarran Reed: Players hit penalty issues "head on" in meeting this week
items.text: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald called the team's seven personal fouls in last Sunday's win over the Chargers "unacceptable at any level" and his players didn't wait to go to work on cleaning things up this week.

items.title: Aaron Rodgers won't comment on whether play calls are coming in fast enough
items.text: After Thursday night's loss in Cleveland, Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers wasn't asked about his viral moment with coach Mike McCarthy, sparked by Rodgers's obvious frustration with the time it was taking to communicate the play call to the huddle.

items.title: Breece Hall remains out of practice for the Jets
items.text: The Jets called running back Breece Hall week-to-week after he suffered a quad injury in their Week 3 loss to the Lions and Wednesday's practice report gave reason to believe his return to action won't come this week.

items.title: Jalen Ramsey, Jamel Dean did not practice on Wednesday
items.text: The Steelers did not have a couple of defensive backs for Wednesday’s practice as they begin to get ready to face the Colts.

items.title: Patriots WR Mack Hollins hopes to practice later this week
items.text: Patriots wide receiver Mack Hollins did not practice on Wednesday, but he hopes to be back on the practice field later this week.

items.title: Ja'Marr Chase, Tee Higgins among six Bengals out of practice
items.text: The Bengals had six players miss Wednesday's practice.

items.title: In joint statement, NFL and NFLPA say drinking celebrations will be permitted
items.text: For "gray area" celebrations, NFL will communicate with player before fining him.

items.title: Giants list Malik Nabers as out of practice
items.text: The first Giants practice of the week was missing a key member of the offense.

items.title: Jayden Daniels up to full practice on Wednesday
items.text: Word last weekend was that Jayden Daniels's practice participation would determine whether he's able to return as the Commanders' starting quarterback against the Giants in Week 5 and Wednesday's injury report offers reason to believe he's moving in the right direction.

items.title: D'Andre Swift, Kyle Monangai, Caleb Williams did not practice Wednesday
items.text: The Bears had several players out of practice to begin Week 5.

items.title: Tyreek Hill divorce case includes audio, video of interactions with ex-wife
items.text: As the divorce trial brought by Keeta Vaccaro against free-agent receiver Tyreek Hill proceeds, plenty of interesting tidbits continue to come to light.

items.title: DeMeco Ryans taking back defensive play-calling for Texans
items.text: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans is taking back defensive play-calling duties, he told reporters in his Wednesday press conference.

items.title: Sauce Gardner: My effort in London "definitely embarrassing to watch"
items.text: The Colts won in London last Sunday, but it was not a day cornerback Sauce Gardner would like to remember.

items.title: Seahawks designate WR Irv Charles for return to practice
items.text: The Seahawks designated receiver Irv Charles for return to practice on Wednesday, the team announced.

items.title: Jesse Minter on Lamar Jackson: A lot of time between now and Sunday
items.text: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson didn't practice on Wednesday because of the hamstring injury that has left doubt about whether he'll play against the Falcons this Sunday, but head coach Jesse Minter isn't ruling him out at this point.

items.title: Cowboys rule out three, list LG Tyler Smith as questionable
items.text: The Cowboys ruled out three players, but they could have their starting left guard back for Thursday Night Football.

items.title: Howie Roseman: Cam Jurgens trade can help us compete for a long period of time
items.text: The Eagles traded Jurgens to the Ravens on Wednesday.

items.title: Todd Monken: I look forward to seeing Dillon Gabriel back out there
items.text: Dillon Gabriel has returned to practice for the Browns after being placed on injured reserve with a back issue in late August.

items.title: Dan Campbell downplays concerns about Sam LaPorta breaking off contract talks with Lions
items.text: Lions head coach Dan Campbell says the report that tight end Sam LaPorta and the team have broken off contract talks is not an issue.

items.title: Raiders open practice window for WR Dont’e Thornton
items.text: The Raiders are getting one of their young offensive players back on the field.

items.title: Texans open practice windows for Tank Dell, Kayden McDonald, Braden Smith
items.text: Wide receiver Tank Dell is back on the practice field in Houston.

items.title: Ben Johnson: Kyle Monangai had 30 carries and he feels it
items.text: It sounds like Bears running back Kyle Monangai should be available for this weekend's game against the Packers, but he might get some rest during the practice week.

items.title: Brian Branch, Cade Mays return to practice for Lions
items.text: The Lions are welcoming a pair of players back to practice this week.

items.title: Texans sign QB Mark Gronowski to active roster
items.text: The Texans added a quarterback to the active roster on Wednesday.

items.title: Jerry Jones on Tony Romo: "He's just getting started"
items.text: CBS and Tony Romo recently parted ways, which means that CBS wanted out and it negotiated a settlement of Romo's remaining contract.

items.title: Lamar Jackson out of Wednesday's Week 5 practice
items.text: The Ravens have brought in a new center, but they don't currently have a healthy quarterback.

items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson, Mack Hollins set to miss practice for Patriots
items.text: The Patriots are set to open the practice week without a couple of key offensive players.

items.title: Eagles trade Cam Jurgens to Ravens
items.text: Baltimore has acquired the two-time Pro Bowler to help solve its injury issues along the offensive line.
